name: Ayame Nayuri
source: The student council president and Haruki's friend.  She is highly intelligent and good at predicting how Haruki will react.  She is popular and extremely enthusiastic about getting students involved with school events, and she is also forgiving, adhering more to what is best for the students than strict interpretations of the rules.
